desc: Contained fence-post replacement scene with a lower section of one weathered, decayed post leaning beside a clean round footing excavation and a separate new pressure-treated post temporarily braced plumb.
reuse_notes: Use for rotted fence-post diagnosis, wood-fence replacement planning, temporary bracing context, footing preparation, and exterior repair-scope articles. It shows a bounded and realistic problem condition, never a JK Prestige project or a substitute for locating utilities, checking property lines, selecting footing depth, or verifying permit requirements.
